turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hi, this is Marcus, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, water is coming through my ceiling and I'm really worried about the damage. My policy number is OS-417212.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry, but I'll need to take a few details from you first. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Aiko Tanaka.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had a water leak at home and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me what happened and when?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It started about an hour ago. The pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water's gone across the whole floor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've got those details.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And can you confirm the address of the property?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 14 Larch Avenue.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, any settlement will be subject to the policy excess and the indemnity limit, and we may pursue subrogation against the other party's insurer.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will you definitely cover all of this?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise the outcome as the claims team decides, but you've done the right thing by reporting it straight away.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Because it's an emergency you can arrange an urgent repair yourself, up to $500, without needing our approval first. Just keep every receipt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ms Tanaka. I've logged your claim under reference CLM-12569, and the home claims team will contact you about the repairs.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the home claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
